questions.question: According to the Newland's law of octaves, how many elements are present in between Potassium and Copper?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 7**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Newland's Law of Octaves**, each octave contains **7 elements** between the first and the eighth element.
 
• Starting from **Potassium (K)**:
 
 
• Potassium (K) - **1st**
 
• Calcium (Ca) - **2nd**
 
• Scandium (Sc) - **3rd**
 
• Titanium (Ti) - **4th**
 
• Vanadium (V) - **5th**
 
• Chromium (Cr) - **6th**
 
• Manganese (Mn) - **7th**
 
 
 
• The **eighth element** is Copper (Cu).
 
• Hence, there are exactly **7 elements** between **Potassium (K)** and **Copper (Cu)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1866, John Newlands, an English scientist, arranged the then-known elements in the order of increasing atomic masses.
 
• He started with the element having the lowest atomic mass (hydrogen) and ended at thorium which was the 56th element.
 
• He found that every eighth element had properties similar to that of the first. He compared this to the octaves found in music.
 
• Therefore, he called it the ‘Law of Octaves’.
 
• According to the Newlands Octaves, the properties of Lithium and Sodium were found to be the same.
 
• It was assumed by Newlands that only 56 elements existed in nature and no more elements would be discovered in the future. But, later on, several new elements were discovered, whose properties did not fit into the Law of Octaves.

• Global warming is the long-term increase in Earth's average temperature.
 
• It is primarily caused by the increase in greenhouse gases (like carbon dioxide and methane) in Earth's atmosphere due to human activities, such as burning fossil fuels for energy and deforestation.
 
• The increased greenhouse gases trap more of the Sun's heat, causing the planet's temperature to rise.
 
• This leads to many changes in natural systems including melting glaciers, more frequent extreme weather events, sea-level rise, and shifts in wildlife populations and their habitats.
 
• This phenomenon has significant impacts on human societies and the natural world.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India gives Advisory Jurisdiction to the Supreme Court of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 143**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per Article 143, the President has the power to address questions to the Supreme Court, which he deems important for public welfare.
 
• The Supreme Court “advises” the President by answering the query put before it.
 
• Article 143 of the Constitution confers Advisory Jurisdiction to the Supreme Court of India.
 
• Article 143: Power of President to consult Supreme Court.
 
 
• If at any time it appears to the President that a question of law or fact has arisen, or is likely to arise, which is of such a nature and such public importance that it is expedient to obtain the opinion of the Supreme Court upon it, he may refer the question to that Court for consideration and the Court may, after such hearing as it thinks fit, report to the President its opinion thereon.
 
• The President may, notwithstanding anything in the proviso to article 131, refer a dispute of the kind mentioned in the said proviso to the Supreme Court for opinion and the Supreme Court shall, after such hearing as it thinks fit, report to the President its opinion thereon.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 133****​**

 
 
• Article 133 deals with the provisions of Appellate Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court from High Courts in regard to Civil matters only.
 
• Under this article in civil cases, an appeal lies to the Supreme Court from any judgment of a high court if the high court certifies.
 
• It involves a substantial question of law of general importance.
 
• The question needs to be decided by the Supreme Court.
 
 
 
• Article 132- 
 
 
• This article is about Appellate jurisdiction of Supreme Court in appeals from High Court in certain cases such as civil, criminal, or other proceedings.
 
• An appeal can be made to the Supreme Court against the judgment of a high court if the high court certifies that the case involves a substantial question of law that requires the interpretation of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Article 142****​**
 
 
• Article 142 of the Indian Constitution grants discretionary power to the Supreme Court of India.
 
• This article allows the Supreme Court to pass any decree or make any order necessary for doing complete justice in any cause or matter pending before it.
 
• It was under this discretionary power that the Supreme Court of India recognized sex work as a profession.
 
• The recognition aims to protect the rights and dignity of sex workers and to ensure their safety and well-being.

questions.question: Pallavi bought a toy for Rs. 128, decorated it at a cost of Rs. 15, and sold the toy for Rs. 130. Find the loss or gain percentage.

Loss = C.P. - S.P.

Loss Percentage = (Loss / C.P.) × 100

Loss = 143 - 130

⇒ Loss = 13

Loss Percentage = (13 / 143) × 100

⇒ Loss Percentage =100 / 11 %

questions.question: In relation to consumer behavior, two indifference curves ___________.

options.text: always intersect each other at right angles.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**never intersect each other**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In relation to consumer behaviour, **two indifference curves never intersect each other.**
 
• An indifference curve shows a combination of two goods that give a consumer equal satisfaction and utility thereby making the consumer indifferent.
 
• Along the curve, the consumer has an equal preference for the combinations of goods shown—i.e. is indifferent about any combination of goods on the curve.
 
• Typically, indifference curves are shown convex to the origin, and no two indifference curves ever intersect.
 
• Standard indifference curve analysis operates on a simple two-dimensional graph.
 
• Each axis represents one type of economic good.
 
• Along the indifference curve, the consumer is indifferent between any of the combinations of goods represented by points on the curve because the combination of goods on an indifference curve provides the same level of utility to the consumer.
 
• The slope of the indifference curve is equal to the marginal rate of substitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Property of indifference curves:

 
 
• The indifference curve convex to the origin.
 
• The indifference curves, higher is the level of satisfaction.
 
• The indifference curve is downward sloping.
 
• As we move down the indifference curve from left to right, the slope of the indifference curve tends to Decline.
 
• Two indifference curves cannot cut each other because Each indifference curve represents a different level of satisfaction.

questions.question: The sum of average variable cost and average fixed cost is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**average cost**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The sum of average variable cost and average fixed cost is known as **average cost**.
 
• Average cost is the **total cost per unit of output**.
 
• It provides an idea of how much it costs to produce one unit of a good or service.
 
• Average cost is crucial for businesses to determine **pricing strategies** and profitability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Average Variable Cost (AVC)**

 
 
• AVC is the **variable cost per unit of output**.
 
• Variable costs vary with the level of output, such as raw materials, labor, and utilities.
 
• AVC is calculated by dividing total variable costs by the quantity of output produced.
 
• It helps businesses in understanding how variable costs change with production levels.
 
 
 
• **Average Fixed Cost (AFC)**
 
 
• AFC is the **fixed cost per unit of output**.
 
• Fixed costs remain constant regardless of the level of output, such as rent, salaries, and insurance.
 
• AFC is calculated by dividing total fixed costs by the quantity of output produced.
 
• As output increases, AFC decreases because the fixed cost is spread over more units.
 
 
 
• **Total Cost (TC)**
 
 
• TC is the sum of all costs incurred in the production of goods or services.
 
• It includes both fixed costs and variable costs.
 
• TC = Total Fixed Cost (TFC) + Total Variable Cost (TVC).
 
• Understanding TC is essential for budgeting and financial planning.
 
 
 
• **Marginal Cost (MC)**
 
 
• MC is the **additional cost incurred by producing one more unit of output**.
 
• It is calculated by the change in total cost divided by the change in quantity produced.
 
• MC helps businesses in decision-making regarding scaling up or down production.
 
• It is crucial for determining the optimal level of production where profit is maximized.

Which of the following statements with regard to the principal axis of a spherical mirror is/are correct?

(a) The pole on the principal axis is similar to the origin of a Cartesian coordinate axes plane.

(b) Distances measured from the pole, along the principal axis opposite to the direction of incident light are negative.

(c) Heights of objects or images above the principal axis and perpendicular to it are considered negative.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Only (a) and (b)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **(a) The pole on the principal axis is similar to the origin of a Cartesian coordinate axes plan**e.

 
 
• The pole of a spherical mirror **is the point where the principal axis intersects the mirror.**
 
• **It serves as the reference point for measuring distances along the principal axis.**
 
• This is conceptually similar to the origin of a Cartesian coordinate system.
 
• **This statement is correct.**
 
 
 
• **(b) Distances measured from the pole, along the principal axis opposite to the direction of incident light are negative.**
 
 
• **According to the New Cartesian Sign Convention** for spherical mirrors:
 
• **Distances measured **against the direction of incident light are considered negative.
 
• Distances measured **in the direction of incident light are positive.**
 
• Thus, the statement aligns with this convention.
 
• **This statement is correct.**
 
 
 
• **(c) Heights of objects or images above the principal axis and perpendicular to it are considered negative.**
 
 
• **According to the New Cartesian Sign Convention:**
 
• **Heights above t**he principal axis are taken as positive.
 
• **Heights below** the principal axis are taken as negative.
 
• Therefore, this statement contradicts the correct convention.
 
• **This statement is incorrec**t.
 
 
 
• **The correct statements are: (a) and (b).**

questions.question: A certain sum under simple interest at a certain rate of interest per annum amounts to Rs. 1,200 in 2 years and to Rs. 1,500 in 3 years. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 1,200

Amount after 3 years = Rs. 1,500

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

Simple Interest (S.I.) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be P and the rate of interest be R%.

After 2 years, Amount = P + (P × R × 2) / 100 = 1,200

After 3 years, Amount = P + (P × R × 3) / 100 = 1,500

Subtract the first equation from the second to find the interest for 1 year:

(P + (P × R × 3) / 100) - (P + (P × R × 2) / 100) = 1,500 - 1,200

⇒ (P × R × 3) / 100 - (P × R × 2) / 100 = 300

⇒ (P × R) / 100 = 300

⇒ P × R = 30,000

Now substitute P × R = 30,000 into the first equation:

P + (P × R × 2) / 100 = 1,200

⇒ P + (30,000 × 2) / 100 = 1,200

⇒ P + 600 = 1,200

⇒ P = 600

Now substitute P = 600 into P × R = 30,000:

600 × R = 30,000

⇒ R = 30,000 / 600

⇒ R = 50%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 50%.**

questions.question:
In a given reaction, which element acts as an ion?

Pb(s) + CuCl₂ (aq) → PbCl₂(aq) + Cu(s)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only Cl₂**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the given reaction, Cl₂ is the only element that forms ions in the aqueous solution.
 
• Pb (lead) and Cu (copper) are in their solid state and do not exist as ions in the given reaction.
 
• CuCl₂ dissociates in water to form Cu²⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.
 
• The presence of Cl⁻ ions in the solution makes Cl₂ the element acting as ions in the reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Redox Reaction:**

 
 
• A redox (reduction-oxidation) reaction is a type of chemical reaction in which the oxidation states of atoms are changed.
 
• In the given reaction, Pb is oxidized from 0 to +2 oxidation state, while Cu is reduced from +2 to 0 oxidation state.
 
 
 
• **Oxidizing and Reducing Agents:**
 
 
• The substance that is reduced (Cu²⁺ in this case) is the oxidizing agent.
 
• The substance that is oxidized (Pb in this case) is the reducing agent.
 
 
 
• **Dissociation in Aqueous Solutions:**
 
 
• When ionic compounds such as CuCl₂ dissolve in water, they dissociate into their constituent ions (Cu²⁺ and 2Cl⁻).
 
• This dissociation is critical in determining the behavior of the compounds in aqueous solutions.
 
 
 
• **Ionic Compounds and Electrolytes:**
 
 
• Ionic compounds like CuCl₂ are considered strong electrolytes because they completely dissociate into ions in solution.
 
• These ions are responsible for conducting electricity in the solution.

questions.question:
When white light is incident on a prism, it undergoes dispersion. In this context, identify the correct option.

(a) Red colour light bends most in the prism.

(b) Speed of violet colour light is the slowest in the prism.

(c) Refractive index of violet colour light is maximum.

(d) Violet is the top most colour and red is the bottom most colour when the prism is erect.

(e) Dispersion is also the reason for the formation of rainbow.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**(b), (c) and (e)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Speed of violet colour light is the slowest in the prism:** Violet light has the shortest wavelength and, therefore, travels the slowest in the prism.
 
• **Refractive index of violet colour light is maximum:** The refractive index depends on the wavelength of light; it is maximum for violet light as it has the shortest wavelength.
 
• **Dispersion is also the reason for the formation of a rainbow:** Dispersion of light causes the separation of white light into its constituent colors, which is responsible for the formation of rainbows.
 
• **Red light bends the least and violet the most:** In a prism, red light, which has the longest wavelength, bends the least, while violet light bends the most.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dispersion of Light:**

 
 
• Dispersion occurs when white light is separated into its constituent colors due to different degrees of refraction for different wavelengths.
 
• When white light passes through a prism, each color refracts (bends) by a different amount, resulting in the spectrum of colors.
 
 
 
• **Refractive Index:**
 
 
• The refractive index of a medium is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced inside the medium.
 
• It varies with the wavelength of light; shorter wavelengths (like violet) have higher refractive indices.
 
 
 
• **Formation of a Rainbow:**
 
 
• A rainbow is formed due to the dispersion, refraction, and reflection of sunlight by water droplets in the atmosphere.
 
• Each water droplet acts like a tiny prism, dispersing the sunlight into its constituent colors and reflecting it back to the observer.

questions.question: What is the best method to dispose of hospital waste?

options.text: Sterilise and separate metals from cotton

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sterilise and separate metals from cotton**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hospital waste management is a complex process that involves sterilizing medical waste to eliminate any pathogens**, followed by proper segregation of waste.
 
• Items **like metals and non-biodegradable materials should be separated from items like cotto**n, which may be biodegradable or need special disposal methods.
 
• **Sterilization techniques such as autoclaving are used to** kill harmful microorganisms in medical waste before disposal or recycling.

• In this process, the combustible portion of the waste is combined with oxygen forming carbon dioxide and water, which are released into the atmosphere.
 
• Incinerators are made in such a way that they do not give off extreme amounts of heat when burning solid wastes.
 
• Suitable temperature and operating conditions are required to achieve incineration.
 
• It reduces the volume of waste up to 20 or 30% of the original volume.
 
• This method of solid waste management releases various greenhouses gases and harmful substances into the atmosphere like dioxins, furans and VOC.

 
• The use of incinerators is crucial to the disposal of hospital waste.
 
• It completely removes the waste and safely removes any microorganisms.
 
• Incineration is the best method of disposal of hospital waste.

questions.question: If x + y = 5 and xy = 4, find the value of x³ + y³.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If x + y = 5 and xy = 4, find the value of x³ + y³.

**Formula used:**

x³ + y³ = (x + y)(x² - xy + y²)

**Calculations:**

x + y = 5

xy = 4

x² + y² = (x + y)² - 2xy

⇒ x² + y² = 5² - 2×4

⇒ x² + y² = 25 - 8

⇒ x² + y² = 17

x³ + y³ = (x + y)(x² - xy + y²)

⇒ x³ + y³ = 5(17 - 4)

⇒ x³ + y³ = 5×13

⇒ x³ + y³ = 65

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
